The increment includes multiple user stories U1-U8. As a developer, we need to estimate effort in workdays using WBS. We must break down activities, state technical/design decisions and assumptions.

U2: derive strategy for module metadata via @ConfigurationProperties for module info command. U3-U8: porting modules from Spring XD to s-c-s repo: http, tcp, twitterstream, twittersearch (source modules), filter, transform (processor modules). So the increment includes new shell commands for s-c-d, new module metadata, and porting 6 modules.

We need to break down development activities. Likely activities: analysis & design, implementation, testing, integration, documentation, etc. But we need to be granular.

Also shell interface: need to implement commands for CRUD operations on streams (deploy, undeploy, list, etc.). Assume using Spring Shell library.

technical_and_design_decisions: Use Spring Shell framework for implementing the CLI interface to the Spring Cloud Data Flow REST API.
Implement REST client using Spring's WebClient (or RestTemplate) to communicate with the data flow server.
Leverage @ConfigurationProperties annotation processor at build time to generate module metadata for the 'module info' command.
Port modules from Spring XD to Spring Cloud Stream using the functional programming model (java.util.function) with @Bean definitions.
Adopt Maven as the build tool and follow existing s-c-s module conventions (e.g., separate modules for sources/processors).
For Twitter modules, integrate with Twitter4J or equivalent library and handle OAuth credentials via application properties.
Use Spring Cloud Stream test binder for integration testing of modules without external middleware.
assumptions: The developer has full access to the Spring XD source code for the modules to be ported (http, tcp, twitterstream, twittersearch, filter, transform).
Spring Cloud Data Flow REST API endpoints for stream operations (create, deploy, undeploy, list, destroy) are stable and documented.
The s-c-s repository already contains a standard project structure with parent POM and module templates.
All external dependencies (e.g., Twitter4J, TCP libraries) are available in public Maven repositories and compatible with Java 17+.
No major changes to the core Spring Cloud Stream framework are required; porting mainly involves adapting configuration and packaging.
The developer is an experienced Spring professional familiar with Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, and relevant APIs.
Effort estimates are based on a single developer working full-time with no interruptions.
Unit and integration tests are expected to cover the main functionality, with continuous integration setup already in place.

activities.activity_description: Review user stories, understand existing codebases (Spring XD, s-c-d, s-c-s), set up development environment, and configure build tools.

activities.activity_name: Shell Interface for Stream Commands (User Story U1)
activities.activity_description: Design and implement Spring Shell commands for stream operations (create, deploy, undeploy, list, destroy) using s-c-d REST API. Includes error handling and output formatting.

activities.activity_name: Module Metadata Strategy via @ConfigurationProperties (User Story U2)
activities.activity_description: Implement annotation processing or runtime reflection to extract property metadata from @ConfigurationProperties classes. Develop 'module info' shell command to display properties.

activities.activity_name: Port http Source Module (User Story U3)
activities.activity_description: Analyze existing XD http source, create new s-c-s module using functional programming model, implement HTTP server (e.g., via Spring WebFlux), add unit/integration tests.

activities.activity_name: Port tcp Source Module (User Story U4)
activities.activity_description: Port TCP source from XD, implement TCP server using Netty or Java NIO, configure serialization/deserialization, write tests.

activities.activity_name: Port twitterstream Source Module (User Story U5)
activities.activity_description: Port Twitter streaming API source, integrate Twitter library, handle OAuth, implement filter language conversion, write tests.

activities.activity_name: Port twittersearch Source Module (User Story U6)
activities.activity_description: Port Twitter search source, implement polling or streaming, handle pagination and rate limits, write tests.

activities.activity_name: Port filter Processor Module (User Story U7)
activities.activity_description: Port filter module as a function that applies an expression-based filter on message payload, write tests.

activities.activity_name: Port transform Processor Module (User Story U8)
activities.activity_description: Port transform module as a function that transforms message payload using SpEL or scripting, write tests.
Perform end-to-end integration tests combining shell, metadata, and all ported modules. Debug and fix any issues across components.
Update project documentation, write user guide for shell commands, module usage, and configuration properties reference.
Self-review code, apply consistent formatting, remove dead code, ensure all tests pass, and prepare pull request.
